Name: Rose Colored Cat
Author: GraceTheChicken
Description:
This mod will change the cat from an orange cat (or whatever it may be if you already have a different cat altering mod installed.)

[b]Installation:
[/b]Optional: While this is optional, I'd recommend backing up your old cat.xnb file.
1. Download the mod.
2. Place the cat.xnb file into your Stardew Valley\Content\Animals.
3. Replace the file 
4. Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Simply changes your cat from orange to rose color.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
